rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 2.1-2.6, two-year split-split plot field experiment at Tarsus, Turkey, with neutron-probe soil water measurement, flow-metered irrigation, yield harvest. Q2: Section 3.4 and Table 1 report WP of SDI versus surface drip; highest WP in SDI IF3 DI50 (21.9 and 24.5 kg m-3) and Table 3 shows irrigation system significantly affected WP in 2014; Section 3.1 reports SDI received slightly less water than surface drip, attributed to reduced soil evaporation.
rows.notes: Study compares SDI and surface drip water use and WP, so own evidence on SSDI and WP exists, but deep drainage was assumed negligible and soil evaporation was not measured (evaporation reduction is asserted, not measured), so Q4 is no. WP differences between systems were not significant in 2013. Single site, soil, crop (eggplant cv. Anamur Karasi); plot scale; no explicit limitations of own results; only LSD values and letter groupings reported, no SD/SE/CI.

rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 2.1-2.6, two-year field experiment with own measurements of soil water, ET, yield and quality.
rows.notes: The study does not measure or report weed growth (or any pest/disease variable) under SDI; the only mention of fewer weed problems under SDI is in the Introduction citing Lamm and Camp (2007) and Irmak et al. (2016). Study shows yield, water use, WP, quality and net income responses of eggplant to surface vs subsurface drip, irrigation frequency and deficit regimes.

rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 2.1-2.6, two-year replicated field experiment. Q2: Section 3.3, Tables 1 and 4: surface drip yielded 7.3 and 11% more than SDI at 3- and 6-day intervals in 2013 (significant), but no significant difference between systems in 2014; Conclusions restate this mixed result. Q4: Section 3.2 and Figs 2-3 report neutron-probe soil water storage in the 60 cm root zone under both drip systems, and Section 3.1/Table 1 report measured ETa (water balance) for SDI vs surface drip, with lower ETa under SDI linked to lower plant height.
rows.notes: Mixed yield effect of SDI across years is directly supported. Intermediate variables (root-zone soil water and ETa) were measured by one method (neutron probe water balance), so Q3 no. Authors recommend 3-day frequency and full irrigation for high yields under both systems and advise against long intervals with deficit, but these are management recommendations rather than a stated requirement for the SDI yield effect, so Q7 conservatively no. Single site/crop/soil, plot scale, no stated limitations of own data, only LSD and letter groupings (no SD/SE/CI).

notes: Full text appears complete. Economic analysis (Table 5) uses two-year averages; some table values contain apparent typos (e.g., Table 4 2014 interval means, Table 2 TSS for SDI IF6 PRD50 in 2014).
